routes.behavior: A learner completes a full addition problem visually from encounter to reflect using mounted UI controls with zero dispatch fallback.

Condition 1 (bundle-1: in-place subdivision) renders in-place subdivided fraction bar segments at conversion beat without juxtaposed or sequential structures.
Condition 2 (bundle-2: juxtaposed) renders distinct before-and-after juxtaposed rows at conversion beat.
Condition 3 (bundle-3: sequential) renders step-by-step cards and connectors at conversion beat.
Condition 4 (bundle-4: premise check) shares in-place choreography with Condition 1 at conversion beat and intentionally renders identical structure.
Condition 1 (bundle-1: matching choices) renders 3 visual matching bars with distractor choices at reflect beat.
Condition 4 (bundle-4: premise check) renders a check-the-premise comparison frame with Yes/No buttons at reflect beat.

Replay under Condition 3 (sequential) activates choreography-sequential replay highlight and step heading.
